items.title: 3 US AI Infrastructure Stocks Facing The 5% Treasury Yield Test
items.summary: AI infrastructure spending is colliding with a jump in the US 10-year yield toward 5%, and that mix is shaking up how investors think about capital-heavy stories. Higher discount rates and pricier debt are forcing a sharper test of which projects might justify their cost. This article walks through three stocks exposed to that theme and shows how each could be positioned as rates, politics and AI ambitions pull in different directions. items.title: KLAC Q3 deep dive: AI and advanced packaging drive growth, supply chain remains in focus
items.summary: Semiconductor manufacturing equipment maker KLA Corporation (NASDAQ:KLAC) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027), with sales up 28.9% year on year to $4.14 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($4.7 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 4.8% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.22 per share was 3.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
